items.title: 3 Financials Stocks to Consider Right Now
items.summary: Financial firms serve as the backbone of the economy, providing essential services from lending and investment management to risk management and payment processing. Market leaders have certainly capitalized on a favorable backdrop to boost profitability, helping fuel a 7.5% gain for the industry over the past six months. This performance has closely followed the S&P 500.
